behaviors.schedule: SIGTERM at stop; wait shutdownTimeoutMs (default 10000); if still alive SIGKILL and record escapedGraceful=true, forceSignal=SIGKILL, escalatedAfterMs. Prompt SIGTERM exit records escapedGraceful=false, forceSignal=null. Trace at src/index.ts:446-449, implementation :466-516.
behaviors.windows: requestGracefulStop on win32 is taskkill /T /F immediately (:325-333), trace mode force-only (:473-496). No console graceful signal exists for these Node children: taskkill /T without /F returns 128 can only be terminated forcefully; process.kill SIGINT exits code 1 without the handler. Two POSIX tests are skipped on this Windows host; no RED/GREEN for the grace schedule was executable.

behaviors.limits: External process-tree enumeration, not a Job Object. A grandchild that breaks away/reparents, appears after the walk, is access-denied, or races PID reuse can escape; supervisor crash has no kill-on-job-close. POSIX stop only signals the direct child.
